evidence: The process temperature was set to 300 °C, according to the results of the precursor decomposition experiments described above. However, the final conditions of the process temperature were elaborated through additional experiments, which are discussed later in this section. In Fig. 5, the growth rates leveled off at 0.55 Å/cycle when the duration of the individual steps was longer than 3 s, suggesting that under these conditions the substrate surface was saturated with the precursor species. Accordingly, the duration of the steps for the introduction of gas streams in the ALD process was fixed to 3 s in the subsequent experiments.
